name: fz556_glaive_rush_sub
purpose: Baxcalibur's Glaive Rush breaks Toxtricity's Substitute (step 20): the null target counts for selfDrops, so the Glaive Rush volatile is set (-singlemove [silent]) and Scary Face hits Baxcalibur later without an accuracy roll (step 22). On main the volatile was missing and the engine stopped with E_INVARIANT at step 22 (issue 556, the cause of issue 518). A battle of the differential fuzzing of issue 396 (free random sets, fz_363_61), whole. The choices and the seed are those of the campaign; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
